description: D1: the Frostbound Titan kneeling frozen in the Rimeglass's ice - a world boss held by his territory (world.hoarfell.frostbound_territory, TitanTerritory: a giant he sees only discovers the tarn; a blow, or a giant walking out onto the ice, wakes him; he hunts to 145 m of the tarn and walks home whole). An arena encounter (no leash), its seat reserved within 200 m (reserve_seat) and his AI at the near tier within 400 m (lod_near_m), as the other titans'. He dies once (persist_death; forbids his outcome flag).
